notes: Settings Scale Slider:: Resolved float truncation in `Settings.tsx` where `parseInt` prevented decimal scale adjustments (0.75x–1.50x), locking the UI zoom factor to 1. | Proxy Checker False-Quarantine:: Added `recordJudgeSuccess` to reset consecutive failure counters upon healthy responses, broadened `isProxyDeadError` to classify proxy connection timeouts and SOCKS 400 Bad Requests as proxy deaths rather than judge outages, and added live direct probes before quarantining so healthy judges are never disabled. | Judge Discovery False Positives:: Hardened `isJudgeShapedBody` to reject blog, documentation, and forum pages (e.g. `proxynova.com/proxy-articles`), preventing informational articles from being falsely registered as live proxy judges.
